metadata.title: Deep Recruitment Benchmarks 2026 - CPC/CPA/CPH/Apply-Rate/Time-to-Fill
metadata.description: Comprehensive recruitment marketing benchmarks covering 12 industry verticals, 40 US metros with cost-of-living multipliers, and 7 primary recruitment channels. Every metric cites a public or syndicated source.
metadata.data_period: 2024-01 through 2025-12 (rolling 24 months); CPH/time-to-fill benchmarks refreshed to SHRM 2025 + 2026 vintage on 2026-06-13
metadata.vintage_note: Per-vertical and per-channel CPC/CPA cells below are sourced primarily to Appcast 2025 (covering 2024 ad data), i.e. 2024-2025 vintage. The Appcast 2026 (10th Annual) report was verified as published on 2026-06-03 (covering 2025 data: 302M clicks, 27.4M applies, ~1,200 US employers) and its qualitative direction (CPA and CPH rose sharply in 2025; apply rates surged; remote roles lost footing) is recorded in source 'appcast_2026' and in market_context_2025. The 2026 report's detailed per-vertical CPC/CPA/CPH figures are gated behind a download form and could NOT be independently verified cell-by-cell, so those numeric cells were left at their cited 2024-2025 values rather than guessed. 2026-06-13 refresh: cost-per-hire and time-to-fill benchmarks were updated against newer tier-1 sources - SHRM 2025 Benchmarking Reports ($5,475 non-exec CPH, $35,879 exec CPH, ~44-day all-industry median TTF; sources shrm_cph_2025 / shrm_ttf_2025), iCIMS/Nucleus 2026 (20-25 day time-to-hire; icims_nucleus_2026), NSI 2026 (78-day experienced-RN TTF; nsi_rn_2026), and Indeed Hiring Lab 2026 (indeed_hiringlab_2026). The all-industry SHRM 2025 baseline CPH/TTF is recorded in cross_references.time_to_fill_benchmarks and cross_references.cost_per_hire_benchmarks_2025. Healthcare/nursing per-cell time_to_fill_days were lifted toward the NSI/SHRM 2025/2026 figures (the legacy shrm_*_2024 figures are retained in source_ids for traceability). Manufacturing/blue-collar, finance, and logistics/warehouse per-cell CPH figures from this round are only available via secondary aggregators (TimeClick, HireVelocity, Drive My Way) and are recorded with confidence:'low' and named sources in cross_references.aggregated_cph_ranges_low_confidence; the per-cell cph_range_usd values for those verticals were NOT overwritten with low-confidence aggregator numbers. Treat per-cell ad costs as a 2024-2025 floor and apply Appcast 2026's documented upward CPA/CPH trend when pricing 2026 plans.

sources.name: Appcast 2026 Recruitment Marketing Benchmark Report (10th Annual, covering 2025 ad data)
key_findings: CPA and CPH rose sharply in 2025 despite a softer labor market.
Apply rates surged, fueled by increased job-seeker volume; white-collar/office apply rates rose significantly.
Frontline standing-up roles (especially healthcare) remained costly and hard to fill.
Remote jobs began losing footing after years of outperforming in-person roles.
Cost increases driven by shifts in job-board pricing and programmatic media models.
Mobile apply share 70.64%, web 29.36%; labour-force supply 170.9M vs demand (openings+employment) 170.3M, near-perfect balance.

sources.note: Covers 2024 ad data. Per-cell figures tagged appcast_2025 below are 2024-vintage; see metadata.vintage_note.

BLS Metropolitan CPI-U 2025
JobTarget/iSEEK Programmatic Benchmarks 2024

key_findings: US average cost-per-hire for non-executive roles is $5,475.
Executive-role cost-per-hire is $35,879 - nearly 7x non-executive and up 21% vs 2022.

sources.name: SHRM 2025 Recruiting Benchmarking Report - Time to Fill
key_findings: All-industry median time-to-fill is ~44 days ('about a month and a half').
Screening and interviewing each average 8-9 days.

sources.name: iCIMS / Nucleus Research ROI study & iCIMS Insights 2026
key_findings: Time-to-hire of 20-25 days for both iCIMS customers and the industry benchmark.
iCIMS customers see 197 applicants/role vs 132 benchmark, 25% application completion vs 24%, 34% qualified vs 31%.

sources.name: Indeed Hiring Lab - 2026 US Jobs & Hiring Trends Report and Feb 2026 signing-bonus analysis
key_findings: Dec 2025: physicians & surgeons 10.6% of postings offered signing bonuses; nursing 8.4% (down from 13.5% Dec 2024).
7 of top 10 signing-bonus occupations were healthcare; healthcare = 47.5% of all 2025 job growth; healthcare postings 22.6% above pre-pandemic.
Technology postings ~one-third lower than early 2020; retail & hospitality postings 7.4% below pre-pandemic; finance unemployment duration up ~20 weeks since 2023.

sources.name: 2026 NSI National Health Care Retention & RN Staffing Report
key_findings: Experienced RN time-to-fill (Recruitment Difficulty Index) is 78 days; ICU/OR/ED specialties 60-90 days.
RN vacancy rate 8.6% (down from 9.6%); RN turnover 17.6%; average cost of staff RN turnover $60,090.

sources.name: The Josh Bersin Company - Time-to-Hire Benchmark Factbook / Talent Acquisition Revolution research
key_findings: Global all-industry average time-to-hire is 44 days (2023 data).
AI tools reported to yield 2-3x faster time-to-hire.

sources.name: LinkedIn Talent Solutions - 2025 Global Recruiting Trends / Reducing time-to-hire resource
key_findings: LinkedIn average all-industry time-to-fill is ~42 days.
~60% of organizations report longer time-to-hire due to interview cancellations / scheduling delays.

sources.name: AMS time-to-hire data (via Genius recruitment statistics)
key_findings: Tech & media time-to-hire ~20 days; hospitality ~14 days; retail ~18 days; finance/investment banking ~21-60 days; engineering ~62 days.

sources.name: NRI Staffing - 2026 healthcare hiring analysis (citing SHRM)
key_findings: General healthcare-role time-to-fill ~49 days vs ~20-25 days for professional/office roles (SHRM, cited).

sources.name: HireVelocity manufacturing cost-per-hire analysis (via Leadline; Easy.jobs industry summary)
sources.note: Secondary aggregator - manufacturing CPH/TTF could not be confirmed against a tier-1 source.
key_findings: Manufacturing CPH ~$5,611; entry-level manufacturing time-to-fill ~33 days; replacing a skilled frontline worker can cost $10,000-$40,000.

sources.name: TimeClick 2025 cost-of-hiring analysis (cited via Pin cost-per-hire benchmarks)
sources.note: Secondary aggregator - per-cell industry CPH ranges could not be confirmed against a tier-1 source.
key_findings: Aggregated CPH ranges: retail/hospitality ~$2,700; technology ~$6,200-$8,000; healthcare ~$9,000-$12,000 (2-3x national avg); skilled trades $12,000+; legal/professional services $16,000-$20,000.

sources.name: Drive My Way / Talent Traction transportation & logistics workforce analysis
sources.note: Secondary aggregator - CDL driver replacement cost could not be confirmed against a tier-1 source.
key_findings: Replacing one semi-truck driver exceeds ~$8,000 (range $550-$9,000 per qualified driver depending on fleet); CDL drivers are the single hardest category to fill in 2026.

methodology_notes: CPC = Cost per click. Ranges reflect the 25th to 75th percentile of observed auctions for the given segment.
CPA = Cost per application (long-form ATS unless flagged easy-apply). Driven by click-through rate and apply rate.
CPH = Cost per hire. Blends sourcing, advertising, recruiter time, referral, and agency fees.
Apply rate = completed applications / clicks on job ad.
Time-to-fill = calendar days from requisition opened to offer accepted.
COLI multiplier = C2ER Cost of Living Index / 100 (US average = 1.00).
Metro multiplier = local CPC and CPA divergence vs national median, blending BLS wages + COLI + Appcast geo data.
Values marked 'estimated' are triangulated from 2+ tier-2 sources when primary benchmark data is unavailable.

market_context_2025._vintage: JOLTS levels/rates here reflect 2025 BLS data and were NOT re-verified against the latest monthly JOLTS release as of 2026-06-03 (bls.gov was unreachable from the refresh environment). Values retained, not guessed forward.

supply_demand_balance_2026.interpretation: Supply and demand in near-perfect balance per Appcast's 2025-data analysis.

market_a_flood.description: White-collar / remote roles with 3-9x application volume growth since 2022. CPA stable or falling.

market_b_drought.description: Frontline / licensed roles where applicant supply has not kept pace with demand. CPA elevated.

healthcare._description: Hospital systems, clinics, long-term care, home health. Highest CPA category overall.

time_to_fill_days._2026_refresh: General healthcare-role median of ~49 days corroborated by SHRM 2025 (cited via NRI Staffing 2026 analysis, source nri_staffing_2026), vs ~20-25 days for professional/office roles. Specialised RN difficulty index runs far higher - see by_industry.nursing.time_to_fill_days.

healthcare.seasonal_pattern: Demand peaks Jan-Mar (enrollment) and Aug-Oct (nursing school grads).
healthcare.notes: Healthcare maintained highest-cost category status through 2024-2025 (Recruitics). CPA trending up +8% YoY. Indeed Hiring Lab 2026 (Dec 2025 data): healthcare = 47.5% of all 2025 US job growth, postings 22.6% above pre-pandemic, and 7 of the top 10 signing-bonus occupations were healthcare (physicians & surgeons 10.6% of postings offered signing bonuses; nursing 8.4%, down from 13.5% in Dec 2024).

nursing._description: RN, LPN, CNA, travel nurses - drought market, licensed roles.

time_to_fill_days._2026_refresh: Refreshed 2026-06-13 to the 2026 NSI National Health Care Retention & RN Staffing Report (527 hospitals, 40 states): experienced-RN Recruitment Difficulty Index = 78 days, with ICU/OR/ED specialties running 60-90 days. Prior values (p25 42 / median 58 / p75 85, shrm_ttf_2024) are superseded but shrm_ttf_2024 is retained in source_ids for traceability.

rn_workforce_2026.note: 2026 NSI report: RN vacancy 8.6% (down from 9.6%), RN turnover 17.6%, average cost of a single staff-RN turnover $60,090.

nursing.seasonal_pattern: Heaviest demand Q1 and Q3. Summer slowdown.
nursing.notes: RN CPA $40 median per Joveo 2026. Travel nursing CPA 25% higher than staff roles. Experienced-RN time-to-fill 78 days per NSI 2026; nursing signing-bonus prevalence fell to 8.4% of postings in Dec 2025 from 13.5% a year earlier (Indeed Hiring Lab 2026).

physician._description: MD, DO across specialties. Very low apply volume, high executive-search component.

signing_bonus_2026.note: Dec 2025: 10.6% of physician & surgeon postings offered signing bonuses - the highest of any occupation tracked by Indeed Hiring Lab.

physician.seasonal_pattern: Continuous - residency cycle (July) creates July-Sep spike.
physician.notes: Physician search typically agency/RPO driven. Ad-only CPH is rarely used; blended CPH includes agency fees that can hit $40-70K.

tech._description: Software engineering, DevOps, data, SRE. Market A - flood category.

time_to_hire_days_2026.note: Tech & media time-to-hire ~20 days (AMS via Genius, 2024); engineering ~62 days. Technology postings ran ~one-third lower than early 2020 per Indeed Hiring Lab 2026. Time-to-hire (offer accepted from candidate entry) differs from the requisition-to-offer time_to_fill_days above.

tech.seasonal_pattern: Sharpest hiring pullback Q2-Q3 2024 through 2025. Renewed growth signaled by Recruitics May 2025 +28.9% MoM CPC.
tech.notes: Software dev saw 9x application growth Nov 2022 to Nov 2025. Candidates with 5+ yrs experience grew from 37% to 42% of applicants.

retail._description: Store associates, shift leads, visual merchandisers. Seasonal-heavy.

time_to_hire_days_2026.note: Retail time-to-hire ~18 days (AMS via Genius, 2024). Retail & hospitality postings ran 7.4% below pre-pandemic per Indeed Hiring Lab 2026.

retail.seasonal_pattern: Massive peak Sep-Nov for holiday. Spring refresh Mar-Apr. Recruitics showed retail YoY CPC +56.3% in June 2025.
retail.notes: Retail apply rates among highest; volume-heavy funnel. Hourly wage inflation pushing CPH up ~8-12% YoY.

logistics._description: Warehouse, CDL drivers, delivery, freight, supply chain ops.

cdl_driver_replacement_cost_2026.note: Secondary aggregator (Drive My Way / Talent Traction); not confirmed against a tier-1 source. Replacing one semi-truck driver exceeds ~$8,000 (range $550-$9,000 per qualified driver depending on fleet); CDL drivers cited as the single hardest category to fill in 2026. Do not overwrite the cph_range_usd cell with this figure.

logistics.seasonal_pattern: Q4 spike (peak season Oct-Dec). Summer steady. Transport YoY CPC remained elevated through 2025.
logistics.notes: CDL driver CPA 70% higher than warehouse. Warehouse saw 5x applicant growth; CDL still drought.

finance._description: Banking, accounting, corp finance, financial analysts, insurance underwriters.

time_to_hire_days_2026.note: Finance / investment banking time-to-hire ~21-60 days (AMS via Genius, 2024). Finance unemployment duration up ~20 weeks since 2023 per Indeed Hiring Lab 2026.

finance.seasonal_pattern: Q1 budget-cycle surge. Recruitics May 2025 Finance & Ops MoM +89.8% signaled strategic-function recovery.

skilled_trades._description: Electricians, plumbers, welders, HVAC, machinists, construction.

manufacturing_aggregator_2025.note: Manufacturing/blue-collar figures available only via secondary aggregator (HireVelocity via Leadline; Easy.jobs). Not confirmed against a tier-1 source; do not overwrite the cph_range_usd cell with these. CPH ~$5,611; entry-level time-to-fill ~33 days; replacing a skilled frontline worker can cost $10,000-$40,000.

skilled_trades.seasonal_pattern: Spring-summer construction peak. Drought conditions year-round.
skilled_trades.notes: BLS 2025 projects 8% trade-worker shortage through 2030. Aging workforce median age 45+.

hospitality._description: Hotels, restaurants, event services, food & beverage front-of-house.

time_to_hire_days_2026.note: Hospitality time-to-hire ~14 days (AMS via Genius, 2024) - fastest of the tracked verticals.

hospitality.seasonal_pattern: Memorial Day through Labor Day peak. Recruitics June 2025 MoM +53.2%. January 2025 YoY +225% due to post-pandemic rebase.
hospitality.notes: Hospitality is most seasonally-volatile category (Recruitics). YoY swings 40-200%+ common.

government._description: Federal, state, municipal civil service. Long cycles, structured hiring.
government.seasonal_pattern: Federal fiscal year (Oct) and state budget cycles drive spikes.
government.notes: Apply rate lowest of any major vertical due to USAJobs 5-20 page assessments.

education._description: K-12 teachers, higher ed faculty/staff, early childhood, edu admin.
education.seasonal_pattern: K-12: Mar-Jul heavy for Aug start. Higher ed: Sep-Dec for Jan start. Substitute hiring year-round.
education.notes: BLS 2024 shows teacher shortages in STEM, special ed, and bilingual across 44 states.

pharma_biotech._description: Pharma R&D, clinical ops, manufacturing, medical science liaisons, regulatory.
pharma_biotech.seasonal_pattern: Steady year-round, slight Q1 and Q3 hiring surges.
pharma_biotech.notes: GLP-1 drug launches driving aggressive 2024-2025 pharma hiring. Manufacturing CPH trending up sharply.

by_metro._description: Top 40 US metros. Cost-of-living multiplier (C2ER Q4 2024), CPC/CPA local multiplier vs national median, and market velocity indicator.
by_metro._multiplier_base: National US median = 1.00. Multiply industry medians above by the metro_cpc_mult or metro_cpa_mult to get local estimates.

by_channel._description: 7 primary US recruitment channels. CPC/CPA ranges, apply-rate, typical use cases, and strengths.

indeed.strength: Broadest reach in US. Best for volume, blue-collar, hospitality, retail, warehouse.
indeed.weakness: High noise, declining apply quality. Stricter attribution rules since 2024 pay-per-apply shift.

linkedin.revenue_model: CPC (Job Slots) / CPA / Talent Insights subscription
linkedin.strength: Highest quality for white-collar, specialized, leadership. Strongest in tech, finance, pharma, consulting.
linkedin.weakness: Most expensive. Low fit for hourly / frontline.

ziprecruiter.strength: AI-match to candidates. Strong SMB penetration. Good for gig, logistics, skilled trades.
ziprecruiter.weakness: Paid employer count pressured in 2024 per 10-K. Lower enterprise share than Indeed.

monster.strength: Long-tail audience, strong in government, manufacturing, trades in secondary markets.
monster.weakness: Declining traffic. Lost market share to Indeed/ZR. Now under CareerBuilder+Monster merger.

glassdoor.strength: Unique employer-brand positioning. Reviews influence 86% of candidate decisions (Glassdoor 2024). Shared traffic with Indeed post-merger.
glassdoor.weakness: Pure apply volume lower than Indeed. Best used for brand + conversion, not raw reach.

dice.strength: Purpose-built for tech/IT/security/cleared roles. Strong cyber, defense, cloud engineer reach.
dice.weakness: Narrow vertical. Expensive per applicant vs Indeed for generalist tech.

programmatic_appcast_jobtarget.revenue_model: Managed bidding across 1000+ job sites on CPC or CPA
programmatic_appcast_jobtarget.network_scale: Distributes to Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Monster, Talroo, Nexxt, and 1000+ niche boards
programmatic_appcast_jobtarget.strength: Auto-optimizes to cheapest + highest-converting sites per job. Best aggregate CPA for volume campaigns.
programmatic_appcast_jobtarget.weakness: Less channel-specific storytelling. Requires feed + CPA target discipline.

mobile_vs_desktop_apply.insight: Mobile drives traffic, desktop drives completion.
mobile_vs_desktop_apply._vintage: mobile_share_pct/apply-rate split is Appcast 2025 (2024 data) vintage; apply-rate split not re-verified for 2026.
mobile_vs_desktop_apply._source_2026: Appcast 2026 Recruitment Marketing Benchmark Report (https://www.appcast.io/2026-benchmark-report/, retrieved 2026-06-03). Note: this is the share of completed applies by device, not click/traffic share.

time_to_fill_benchmarks._2026_refresh: SHRM 2025 Recruiting Benchmarking Report confirms the all-industry median time-to-fill at ~44 days ('about a month and a half'), with screening and interviewing each averaging 8-9 days (source shrm_ttf_2025). The 44-day figure is corroborated by The Josh Bersin Company global time-to-hire (44 days, 2023 data) and broadly consistent with LinkedIn's ~42-day average; iCIMS/Nucleus 2026 reports a faster 20-25 day time-to-hire for ATS-managed funnels.

all_industry_time_to_hire_days_2026.note: Time-to-hire (candidate entry to offer accepted) is distinct from requisition-to-offer time_to_fill_days used in the per-industry cells above. ~60% of organizations report longer time-to-hire due to interview cancellations / scheduling delays (LinkedIn); AI tools reported to yield 2-3x faster time-to-hire (Josh Bersin).

cost_per_hire_benchmarks_2025.note: SHRM 2025 Talent Acquisition / Recruiting Benchmarking Report (survey of 2,371 members, Jan-Mar 2025): US average cost-per-hire for non-executive roles is $5,475; executive roles average $35,879 - nearly 7x non-executive and up 21% vs 2022. This is the confirmed all-industry CPH baseline; per-vertical cph_range_usd cells above remain at their cited vintages and were not forced to this single national figure.

authoritative_sources.source: SHRM 2025 Talent Acquisition / Recruiting Benchmarking Report (survey of 2,371 members, Jan-Mar 2025)

icims_nucleus_funnel_2026.note: iCIMS / Nucleus Research ROI study (1,000+ TA leaders, published May 2026): both iCIMS customers and the broader industry benchmark hit 20-25 day time-to-hire; iCIMS customers see higher applicant volume, completion, and qualified rates.

aggregated_cph_ranges_low_confidence._description: Industry CPH ranges available only via secondary aggregators in the 2026-06-13 refresh. Tagged low confidence with their named sources per data-steward policy; NOT used to overwrite the tier-1-sourced cph_range_usd cells in by_industry.

authoritative_sources.source: TimeClick 2025 cost-of-hiring analysis (aggregated, cited via Pin cost-per-hire benchmarks)
HireVelocity (cited via Leadline manufacturing CPH analysis); Easy.jobs industry summary
Drive My Way / Talent Traction transportation & logistics workforce analysis
